responsibility: This implementation module provides straightforward ASCII case-conversion helpers by walking nul-terminated character arrays and mapping letters through Cap and Lower. It uses StrLib.StrLen to bound copies, preserves truncation and termination behavior for destination buffers, and implements per-character case changes with direct ordinal arithmetic, making it a small text-normalization utility rather than a general string library.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the StrCase pair: it defines StrToUpperCase, StrToLowerCase, Cap, and Lower with explicit ASCII ordinal arithmetic and uses StrLib.StrLen to manage bounded nul-terminated copies declared in StrCase.def.
